q: What does Agra's footwear component cluster use in energy, and which product uses most?
title: Agra footwear components: energy and CO2
short: Plastic soles: 5,429 of the 8,624 toe that Agra's 205 or so component units used in 2014-15, by TERI's count, about 63%. The cluster drew 59 million kWh of power, 2,880 kL of diesel and 1.2 million scm of gas, roughly 50,000 t CO2 a year on today's factors, mostly from electricity.
audience: Plastic sole, heel, last and shoe sheet makers in Foundry Nagar and Sikandra, Agra, and the shoe brands that buy from them

ul: Plastic soles: 150 units, about 37,200 tonnes a year. Across the cluster, raw materials include PVC, TPR, TPU, PP, ABS, HDPE and natural or SBR rubber.
Shoe sheets: 20 units, about 4,740 tonnes. Shoe lasts: 12 units, about 3,402 tonnes. Plastic heels: 20 units. Leather soles: 3 units.
About 75% of units are unregistered. Most have LT connections of 50 to 215 kVA, with diesel or gas generators for back-up.
Gas and diesel also fire thermic fluid heaters in rubber sole units.

p: Specific consumption ran from 0.91 to 2.67 kWh per kg. Lasts were highest at 2.67 kWh per kg and weigh 2 to 2.2 kg a pair, so a pair of lasts carries far more energy than a pair of soles at about 0.4 kg. When a brand asks for a figure per pair, weigh what you ship: kg per pair times kWh per kg is the honest way to split a month's bill across mixed products.

sections.h: Where the power goes and what cuts it
ul: Barrel heaters on moulding machines and extruders, often on/off controlled and poorly insulated. Radiant heater bands with thyristor control save 20% to 30%.
Hydraulic injection moulding machines. All-electric machines use 50% to 80% less; among hydraulic machines, a servo motor on the pump is the most efficient.
Compressors, chillers and cooling towers, the usual leak and pressure fixes.

example.title: Worked example: cluster CO2 and one pair of soles
lines: Electricity: 59 million kWh x 0.675 kg CO2 per kWh = about 39,800 t
Diesel: 2,880 kL x 2.645 kg CO2 per litre = about 7,600 t
Gas: 1.2 million scm x 2.05 kg CO2 per scm = about 2,500 t; total about 50,000 t a year
A 0.4 kg pair of soles at an assumed 1.4 kWh per kg: 0.56 kWh x 0.675 = about 0.38 kg CO2 from moulding power
example.note: The 1.4 kWh per kg is an assumption inside TERI's 0.91 to 2.67 range; use your own bills and kg shipped. Material (PVC, TPR, rubber) is a separate Scope 3 line.
